screenshots.description: Baseline: Alpha → Beta → Alpha loses the final visit.
Candidate: all three visits and End Alpha.
320px: wrapped endpoints and keyboard-focused horizontal rail.
320px: same rail scrolled to the fourth/final visit.
Route-element capture at a 320px viewport: all four repeated Now labels wrap and remain visible.
390px Storybook: wrapped endpoints and reachable rail.
390px Storybook: Now route wraps without deleting visits.
Route-element capture at a 320px viewport in dark theme: the same complete route.
1600px: main Now route and wide right rail preserve the same complete sequence.

excludedDiagnosticRuns: Initial 32/32 browser run had missing CJK glyph fallback. Those PNGs are excluded. Final suite adds real Tab traversal, hit testing, rail-end capture and 1600px right-rail coverage.
